title: ECOD AI/BI & Genie Question Bank
header: * ECOD AI/BI & Genie Question Bank v{version} - the published, finalized catalogue
* for the Senior Databricks AI/BI & Genie Consultant track.
* Organised MODULE -> FAMILY -> QUESTION. Generated by
* scripts/build-question-bank.py from the published source workbook
* ("AI BI G Question bank 1.1.xlsx"); edit the generator (or the Admin UI),
*   G01, G02, A01, S01, S02, Q01, R01   Technical     3 objective + 1 open served per module
*   F01, C01, D01                       Consulting    1 open served per module
* Every generated test is (7 x 4) + (3 x 1) = 31 questions, shuffled so
* objective and open questions interleave rather than arriving in blocks.
* See src/core/test-generation.mjs for the selection logic.
* FAMILIES ARE SCOPED TO A MODULE. Each module in this bank is built around
* the question family the source workbook names for it, so the compound id
* `S02:obo-authentication-role-security`). A new question is added to exactly
* one such family, and `family_id` is what pins it there.
* `needs_option_review` marks an objective question that still needs an admin
* to complete its distractor text. The published v1.1 workbook carries all
* four options, so published objectives no longer set it.
groups: AI/BI & Genie platform depth: Genie spaces, semantic layer, target architecture, governance, security, QA and production readiness.
Use-case discovery, commercial workflows and documentation handover.
